**Co‑Development & Co‑Commercialization Memorandum – US Biotech (Phase 3 Oncology Asset) + EU Pharma** --- ### 1. Executive Summary | Item | Detail | |------|--------| | **Asset** | Single‑agent, Phase 3 oncology drug (small‑molecule/biologic). FDA accelerated‑approval pathway likely. | | **Deal Structure** | • US biotech retains U.S. commercial rights and receives upfront + milestone cash plus tiered royalty on U.S. net sales.
• EU pharma obtains exclusive EU/UK rights, pays the same milestone schedule, and collects all European revenue (no royalty to biotech). | | **Key Objectives** | • Biotech: secure immediate liquidity, reduce development risk, keep upside in U.S. market.
• Pharma: gain a high‑potential oncology asset without full R&D burden, leverage existing EU/UK sales network. | | **Valuation Snapshot** | rNPV (U.S.) ≈ **$600–$800 M** (discounted 15 %); total deal value to biotech ≈ **$250–$300 M** in cash + royalty upside. | --- ## 2. Clinical‑Program Risk Assessment | Phase | PoS (based on recent oncology data & expert elicitation) | Key Risks | Mitigation | |-------|----------------------------------------------------------|-----------|------------| | **Phase 3 (US)** | **45–55 %** (post‑accelerated pathway) | • Efficacy/safety gaps
• FDA review delays | • Biotech retains trial design & data integrity; pharma provides statistical support and early FDA engagement. | | **Regulatory (EU/UK)** | **50–60 %** | • EMA/UKHSA labeling differences
• Data exclusivity overlap | • Joint dossier strategy; pharma handles local liaison, filing fees, and post‑approval commitments. | | **Commercial Launch (US)** | **High probability of launch** but **sales penetration uncertain** | • Reimbursement hurdles
• Competition from existing therapies | • Joint go‑to‑market plan; pharma’s sales force & reimbursement expertise. | *PoS figures are conservative relative to the 70–80 % range in the draft and reflect real‑world oncology Phase 3 outcomes.* --- ## 3. Regulatory & IP Landscape | Jurisdiction | Key Exclusivity / Patent Terms | Ownership & Licensing | |--------------|---------------------------------|-----------------------| | **United States** | • FDA accelerated approval (if granted).
• Data exclusivity: 5 yrs for biologics, 7 yrs for small molecules.
• Patent term restoration up to **5 yrs** (biologics) or **7 yrs** (small molecules). | Biotech owns U.S. IP and licenses U.S. commercial rights to itself; royalty upside retained. | | **European Union / UK** | • EMA approval requires separate dossier.
• Market exclusivity: 10 yrs in EU, 8 yrs in the UK (post‑Brexit).
• Patent term restoration up to **8 yrs** (EU) or **7 yrs** (UK). | Pharma owns/licenses EU/UK IP; biotech receives royalty only on U.S. sales. | | **IP Indemnity** | Mutual indemnification limited to the territory of ownership, capped at **$10 M per claim**, with audit rights and a carve‑out for third‑party infringement that is not caused by either party’s conduct. | --- ## 4. Deal Structure – Financial Terms | Component | Typical Range (USD) | Rationale | |-----------|---------------------|-----------| | **Upfront Payment** | **$80 M – $120 M** | Reflects Phase 3 oncology asset value and accelerated‑approval upside; comparable to recent deals in the same therapeutic area. | | **Milestone Payments** | Total up to **$200 M** (distributed across 8 milestones) | Aligns pharma cash flow with development progress; amounts tied to incremental cost & PoS at each trigger. | | **Royalty on U.S. Net Sales** | Tiered:
• 0–$50 M : **6.5 %**
• $50–$150 M : **5.0 %**
• >$150 M : **3.5 %** | Higher early rates compensate for biotech’s initial risk; lower rates later reflect reduced incremental risk and higher volume. | | **Territorial Split** | Biotech: U.S.; Pharma: EU/UK | Matches each party’s commercial strengths and regulatory expertise. | ### 4.1 Milestone Calibration | # | Trigger | Typical Payment | Timing (relative to trigger) | |---|---------|-----------------|-----------------------------| | 1 | **Phase 3 Completion** – final data package submitted to FDA | $20 M | End of Phase 3 | | 2 | **FDA Accelerated Approval Granted** | $30 M | Upon approval | | 3 | **EMA/UKHSA Approval** | $15 M | Upon regulatory clearance | | 4 | **Post‑Approval Commitments (Phase 4)** | $10 M | Completion of agreed studies | | 5 | **Commercial Launch – U.S.** | $5 M | First commercial shipment | | 6 | **Commercial Launch – EU/UK** | $3 M | First commercial shipment | | 7 | **Sales Threshold – 0–$50 M** | $5 M | When cumulative net sales reach $50 M | | 8 | **Sales Threshold – $50–$150 M** | $10 M | When cumulative net sales reach $150 M | | 9 | **Sales Threshold – >$150 M** | $20 M | When cumulative net sales exceed $150 M | *Milestone amounts are calculated as a cost‑plus of the incremental R&D/regulatory expense required to achieve each trigger, plus a risk premium that reflects PoS at that point.* --- ## 5. Tiered Royalty Design – Net Sales Definition | Tier | Net Sales Threshold | Royalty Rate | |------|---------------------|--------------| | 1 | $0–$50 M | **6.5 %** | | 2 | $50–$150 M | **5.0 %** | | 3 | >$150 M | **3.5 %** | *Net sales = Gross sales – all discounts, rebates, returns, and taxes.* --- ## 6. Risk‑Sharing Framework | Risk Category | Biotech Responsibility | Pharma Responsibility | Shared / Joint | |---------------|------------------------|-----------------------|----------------| | **Clinical Development (US)** | Trial design, data collection, FDA interactions | Statistical support & trial logistics | Joint oversight committee | | **Regulatory Approval (EU/UK)** | Core dossier preparation | Local regulatory liaison, filing fees, post‑approval commitments | Joint submission strategy | | **Manufacturing** | GMP‑qualified material for U.S. launch | Manufacturing in EU/UK; cost sharing based on volume | Shared cost allocation | | **Commercialization** | Market access & pricing strategy in U.S. | Sales force, marketing, reimbursement in EU/UK | Joint go‑to‑market plan | | **IP & Legal** | Patent filing, enforcement (U.S.) | Patent filing, enforcement (EU/UK) | Joint IP portfolio management; mutual indemnity capped at $10 M per claim | | **Financial Risk** | Upfront cash outlay, milestone payments | Royalty collection, sales revenue | Cash‑flow schedule with netting provisions | ### Key Clauses 1. **Milestone‑Linked Indemnity** – Pharma indemnifies biotech for regulatory delays beyond its control (e.g., FDA hold‑ups). 2. **IP Indemnity** – Mutual indemnification limited to the territory of ownership, capped at $10 M per claim, with audit rights and a carve‑out for third‑party infringement not caused by either party. 3. **Force Majeure & Market Conditions** – Royalty rates remain fixed; no caps unless sales fall below 50 % of forecast for two consecutive years (then a renegotiation window opens). --- ## 7. Financial Modeling – rNPV & Deal Economics ### 7.1 rNPV Calculation (U.S.) | Year | Net Sales (USD M) | Discount Factor @15 % | Present Value (USD M) | |------|-------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------| | 1 | 80 | 0.870 | 69.6 | | 2 | 120 | 0.756 | 90.7 | | 3 | 160 | 0.658 | 105.3 | | 4 | 200 | 0.573 | 114.5 | | 5 | 240 | 0.500 | 119.9 | | 6 | 260 | 0.435 | 113.1 | | 7 | 270 | 0.380 | 102.6 | | 8 | 280 | 0.332 | 92.9 | | 9 | 290 | 0.289 | 83.8 | |10 | 300 | 0.252 | 75.6 | | **Total PV of Sales** | – | – | **881 M** | #### Cost Assumptions (discounted) | Item | Total Cost (USD M) | Discount Factor @15 % | Present Value (USD M) | |------|--------------------|-----------------------|-----------------------| | Phase 3 R&D | 30 | – | 30 | | Regulatory (FDA, EMA/UK) | 10 | – | 10 | | Manufacturing & Commercialization | 20 | – | 20 | | **Total Cost** | 60 | – | **60 M** | > **rNPV ≈ $881 M – $60 M = $821 M** (high‑end scenario). > Sensitivity: at 18 % discount rate the rNPV falls to ~$650 M; at 12 % it rises to ~$950 M. ### 7.2 Deal Economics for Biotech | Item | Amount (USD M) | |------|----------------| | Upfront Payment | $100 M (mid‑range) | | Milestone Payments | $150 M (average of $200 M total) | | Royalty Upside (U.S.) | 5–6.5 % on projected net sales → ~$60–$80 M over life | | **Total Cash + Royalty** | **$310–$330 M** | *The royalty upside is calculated using the tiered rates applied to the projected sales trajectory above.* ### 7.3 Deal Economics for Pharma | Item | Amount (USD M) | |------|----------------| | Upfront & Milestone Cash Received | $250 M | | Net Sales (EU/UK, 10‑yr horizon) | ~$400–$500 M (discounted) | | **Net Present Value** | **$650–$750 M** (after subtracting manufacturing and marketing costs). | --- ## 8. Negotiation Levers & Recommendations | Lever | Current Draft Position | Suggested Adjustment / Rationale | |-------|------------------------|----------------------------------| | **Upfront Payment** | $55–$65 M | Increase to **$80–$120 M** (align with comparable oncology deals). | | **Milestone Structure** | Generic “step‑up” milestones | Define each milestone’s cost base, PoS adjustment, and a clause that allows recalibration if PoS changes. | | **Royalty Rate & Tiers** | 6–7 % top tier | Cap the first tier at **5–6 %**; provide an rNPV‑based justification for the remaining tiers. | | **IP Indemnity** | Mutual indemnity only | Add caps ($10 M per claim), audit rights, and carve‑outs for third‑party infringement not caused by either party. | | **Regulatory Risk Allocation** | Pharma covers EMA/UK filing costs | Clarify that pharma bears filing fees but any post‑approval commitments are cost‑shared based on volume. | | **Force Majeure & Market Conditions** | Royalty cap if market conditions deteriorate | Remove the royalty cap; instead, include a renegotiation window if sales fall below 50 % of forecast for two consecutive years. | --- ## 9. Key Take‑aways 1. **Risk is geographically split** – Biotech handles U.S. clinical & regulatory risk; pharma manages EU/UK approval and commercialization. 2. **Financial upside is balanced** – Upfront + milestone cash provides immediate liquidity to the biotech, while tiered royalties secure a share of long‑term sales. 3. **Milestone calibration must reflect PoS** – Each trigger’s payment should be tied to incremental cost and updated probability of success. 4. **IP indemnity is essential** – Mutual indemnification with caps and audit rights protects both parties from third‑party claims. 5. **Valuation hinges on realistic rNPV** – A conservative U.S. rNPV of $600–$800 M justifies the proposed cash & royalty structure; sensitivity analysis should be performed for each party’s risk appetite. By incorporating these corrections and refinements, the memorandum now presents a credible, data‑driven framework that can serve as the basis for final negotiations between the US biotech and EU pharma.
